title: Chromatin Remodeling and Histone-Based Gene Regulation
method: Actual saved HTML p.teaching-prose whitespace-delimited count; excludes headings, figures, tables, practice and answers, revision, references and UI. Total article count excludes SVG and buttons. Worked examples identified in sections 3–6, 12–13.

comparator.comparison: Comparable narrative depth, causal exposition and separate practice. 3.D.07 also examined for scope continuity.

scope_review: Official merged CSIR–UGC–DBT syllabus Jan 2026 page 4, separate CSIR NET page 3 and archived MP SET 2024 page 3 visually checked. Approved Academy roadmap boundaries retained; detailed histone anatomy, RNA processing, DNA methylation and epigenetic inheritance belong to other nodes.

coverage.foundations: Sections 1–4: access, position, occupancy and packaging
coverage.history: Section 2: cytology, Allfrey, yeast genetics, Gcn5 and histone code
coverage.structure_mechanism: Sections 3–9: core geometry, ATP remodeling, families, histone chemistry
coverage.physical_chemical: Sections 3–8,12: electrostatics, thermodynamics, ATP coupling, donors and kinetics
coverage.regulation: Sections 7–12: modifiers, readers, recruitment, feedback, activation/repression
coverage.mathematical: Sections 3–6,12–13: equilibrium, conditional binding, ATP budget, turnover, kinetic switching and normalization
coverage.experimental: Section 13: MNase, DNase, targeted ChIP, nascent RNA, reconstitution, reporter and rescue
coverage.perturbations_exceptions_applications: Sections 4–14: catalytic versus targeting defects, context-dependent marks, mimics, transgene position and disease
coverage.integration_exam: Sections 11–14 and all assessment sections; connections to neighboring nodes

scientific_review.pass_1: Reviewed 147-bp core and H1 distinction, transient DNA exposure, thermal equilibrium vs kinetic models, ATPase coupling, remodeler families, donor chemistry and charge, H3K4/H3K36/H3K9/H3K27 context, LSD1 specificity, incompatible K27 states, causal inference and histone normalization. Source records for Allfrey 1964, Brownell 1996, Polach/Widom 1995, Shogren-Knaak 2006 and Carrozza 2005 checked. Teaching datasets explicitly hypothetical.
scientific_review.pass_2: Re-read theory and practice for progression and boundary; revised 15 Part B distractor sets, revised Part C repeat-length comparison, randomized balanced answer key, adjusted graph annotation, re-fetched chapter and checked unique paragraphs, answer mapping, markup nesting and anchor/zoom targets. No duplicated theory paragraphs.

arithmetic_checks.method: Independent JavaScript recomputation of 29 values covering equilibrium, affinity, ATP energy, spacing, fraction/half-time, turnover, switching, synthesis and normalization; revised second repeat length 200−147=53 bp additionally checked. Graph samples calculated from equation.

academic_self_review.method: Two separate internal editorial passes, not external review. Deductions: incomplete primary full-text access (1), historical raw data not independently reanalyzed (1), no external examination calibration (1), interactive browser/device and full accessibility testing unavailable (2).
